existing_scope: documented E2 country, indicator and year route only

authentication: No API key is required by the documented V2 Indicators API.
attribution: Preserve World Bank source, indicator, database, unit, metadata and update attribution.
retention: Retain bounded source representations and proof artifacts; deduplicate by representation digest.
personal_data_treatment: Use aggregate public indicators only; reject unexpected record classes containing personal profiles.
license_notes: Existing E2 policy evidence is not a blanket license or bulk-scope approval; E4 expansion requires human review.
emergency_disable: No scheduler or network work order exists; future jobs must honor the source kill switch and exact-host revocation.
initial_scope: Proposed 150 to 300 reviewed aggregate indicators across explicit economy and year bounds; no undocumented endpoints.
